# Lionheart Fixt 0.10.0 - Montserrat

Montserrat shipped as five maps, one conversation and sixty identical fights. That was the act
where the game ran out, so this is the first release that is mostly new -- built, everywhere it
could be, from things the game shipped and never used.

**Fixt** is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt: it fixes
what is broken, restores what was cut, and adds new content only where the game plainly ran out.

## What's there now

Human assassins and a priestess in the packs, a sentry who calls for help, an ambush, a poisoned
tripwire, a trapped chest. The Templar captain's journal at the gate, and one of the killers
still breathing among the dead, who can be questioned. Sahar, the rearguard's captain, who
speaks before she fights and fights in phases -- or alone, if you can outwit her. An abbey you
can read: ten things to click between the gate and the empty reliquary, more of them for a
perceptive, educated, Sylvant, Wielder or Inquisition character. Nobody says where the monks
went.

## Also

Quinn's earned potions appear in his ordinary shop. The Desoto brothers reunite, and Juan
can't be drained. The Anatomist perk works. The Saladin summit ends. The peaceful road through
the sewers reaches the hide and the cure.

## Before you install

Montserrat needs a character who has never entered it. Everything dialogue-only works on any
save. Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`.
